title: Classic Denim Jacket
description: A timeless denim jacket crafted from mid‑weight cotton for everyday layering. Designed with a structured fit, button‑front closure, and chest pockets for versatile styling. Ideal for casual outfits year‑round.

title: Essential Fleece Hoodie
description: A soft fleece hoodie made for comfort and durability. Features a spacious front pocket, adjustable drawstrings, and a relaxed cut. Perfect for lounging or layering on cooler days.

title: High‑Rise Black Leggings
description: Sleek, supportive leggings made with a stretchy, sculpting fabric that moves with you. The high‑rise waistband provides a smooth silhouette, ideal for workouts or everyday wear.

title: Floral Ruffle Dress
description: A lightweight, flowy dress with a floral print and ruffled detailing. Designed with a wrap-style bodice and soft fabric for a flattering fit. Ideal for warm-weather outings or special occasions.

title: Premium Knit Sweater – Sand
description: A cozy knit sweater crafted from a soft, breathable blend. Designed with a crew neckline and ribbed detailing at the cuffs and hem. A versatile everyday staple.

title: Slim-Fit Chino Pants – Khaki
description: Tailored chinos made from durable, comfortable cotton. Features a slim fit, belt loops, and side pockets—perfect for both casual and semi-formal outfits.

title: Crisp White Button-Up Shirt
description: A classic wardrobe essential. This button-up shirt is made from smooth, breathable cotton with a structured collar and adjustable cuffs. Ideal for office wear or polished everyday looks.

title: Satin Slip Dress – Copper
description: A sleek satin dress with a smooth, glossy finish and delicate straps. Designed with a bias-cut drape that flatters the natural shape. Perfect for evening events or layering.

title: Lightweight Utility Jacket – Olive
description: A durable utility jacket with multiple pockets, adjustable drawstrings, and a zip-front with snap closures. A functional outer layer for everyday wear.

title: Minimalist White Sneakers
description: Clean, low‑profile sneakers designed with a smooth upper and tonal laces. Comfortable, versatile, and perfect for pairing with jeans, chinos, or dresses.
